Oh yeah, you need to fork the repository. There's a button for it on the top-right of GitHub, and it creates a copy of everything on your own GitHub account. You can then push to that, and when you have something completed, submit a pull request back to the main repo.

GitHub (git in general, really) doesn't have a permission level between "read only" and "this person can destroy the entire repo", so forking is how it has to be done.

Also, as an aside, make all changes on the develop branch or a branch from develop, and when you submit a pull request, make sure you're doing it to the develop branch of the main repo. That just makes everything a lot easier for me to manage.

Sonic '06 by far. Literally everything that could go wrong with a game, went wrong in Sonic '06. It feels like an alpha while playing it.

I'm not exaggerating when I say the camera is the largest obstacle when trying to play the game. Sonic is a side-scroller/platformer, yet I would often get stuck with a top-down perspective, even on flat ground or while fighting a boss.

The over world feels incredibly empty and bland. This is unfortunate because it's often unclear on how to progress to the next mission, so I ended up stuck wandering around. In desperation I tried a handful of the side missions. The side missions were pretty generic, but frustration really set in when failing a mission. Not because of the difficulty, but because of the loading screens. Failing a mission would take you back to the over world, and you would have to reinitiate dialogue to try the mission again. This took about 90-120 seconds. And

most of these side missions only took about 30-60 seconds to actually complete.

If Sonic '06 has any redeeming quality, at least the cutscenes look pretty good. But that doesn't make up for a ridiculous and nonsensical story. Sonic is a blue anthropomorphic hedgehog that runs really fast. He's a cartoon character, don't try and create a love story (especially with a person!) or compelling thought out story. It just seems bizarre.

It's hard to put into words how terrible this game is. I read the reviews, and watched let's plays of it before playing it myself. But you can't grasp how non-functional Sonic '06 is until you play it yourself.
